description: The bar chart compares the proportions of three categories: Context, Generated Response, and Other, across two different conditions: the original and the standard. The horizontal axis represents the conditions, with the original condition on top and the standard condition below. The vertical axis is unlabeled, but it shows the percentage values for each category. In the original condition, Context accounts for 60.6%, Generated Response for 31.7%, and Other for 7.7%. In the standard condition, Context is 23.6%, Generated Response is 51.1%, and Other is 25.3%. The bars are color-coded with blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
